2018 under Section 354(D)/506/509/34 registered at Police Station Dabri on the ground of settlement.

4. CRL.M.C. 8228/2023 has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.587/2018 dated 5th December,
2018 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC registered at Police Station Gazipur on the ground of settlement.
5. The present FIRs arose out of a matrimonial dispute between the parties.
No child was born out of the wedlock.

Now the parties have settled all their disputes in terms of: Memorandum of Settlement dated 23rd May 2023, along with addendum thereto dated 21st September, 2023, which has been filed as Annexure P-7 and P-8 in CRL.M.C.8228/2023 and Annexure P-4 and P-5 in CRL.M.C.8225/2023.
6.
The parties have also been granted divorce by mutual consent.

7. As per the settlement, a sum of Rs.18,00,000/- has already been paid to the respondent no.2.
8.
Issue notice.

9. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State and the counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no.2.
10.
The respondent no.2 is present in Court and has been identified by her counsel as well as by the Investigating Officer (IO).
She informs the Court that she has settled the matter of her own free will and without any coercion.
She further states that she has no objection to quashing of the FIRs.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 02:55:16 11.
The petitioners are also present in Court and have been identified by their counsel.
They affirm the statement of the respondent no. 2 and undertake to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.
12. Considering the above settlement between the parties, there is no use continuing with the proceedings of the present FIRs.

Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
13.
Consequently, the FIR No.484/2018 registered at Police Station Dabri and FIR No. 587/2018 registered at Police Station Gazipur and the proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
